text:
anna: Heads-up: we need a quick vendor carveout sync for the marketplace announcement. H100 / H200 / B200, MI300, Gaudi — sequencing + SI handoffs. Aiming to finalize embargo windows & PR ownership by EOD Wed. Who's online?

raj: I can run the vendor blockers list. Q: do we have a final SKU list from partners? NVIDIA said 'subset' but didn't hand off final assets.

tess: marketing needs a final hero SKU for the press kit. if H100 + Gaudi are both in wave1 it's a pain for imagery. can we consider pushing Gaudi to wave2?

nick: infra note — B200 image builds require driver patch (2.12) and a firmware smoke cert. that'll need ~48h once drivers arrive. if we move Gaudi to wave2 we can parallelize CI.

anna: ok proposal: wave1 = H100 + H200 (press + limited SI partners), wave2 = MI300 + Gaudi (marketplace listing + broader SI), wave3 = B200 backfill. that buys ~2 weeks for certs. thoughts?

raj: sounds reasonable. i'll confirm with vendor PMs. @partner-bot could you ping vendor leads and add a calendar block?

partner-bot: noted. pinging @nvidia-pm, @amd-pm, @habana-pm. calendar: Vendor-announce-sync Thu 09:00 PT (30m) — invite sent to the 'marketplace-onramp' list.

tess: marketing follow-ups — we need: consolidated dev image name, sample perf lines for the announcement, and a hero visual by Tue EOD. nick, can you provide perf numbers for H100 (8x) and Gaudi (16x) for the teaser?

nick: will drop numbers by tomorrow noon. preliminary samples: H100 (8x) p50 ~1.2ms/token; Gaudi (16x) p50 ~1.5ms/token — still running regression suites.

raj: SI handoff question — who owns validation for SI integrations? planning to include runbook + acceptance criteria in the marketplace listing. @tina?

tina: happy to own SI validation. i'll draft acceptance criteria and a checklist: connectivity, image smoke, model correctness, perf regression threshold.

anna: assigning Tina for SI validation + @devex to own marketplace publishing checklist. also need an embargo holdback list (who has final say on PR publishing).

tess: :thumbsup: i'll prepare two hero visual options assuming H100 main image; will keep Gaudi variant in reserve.

nick: one more blocker — B200 firmware issue could slip 3-5 days. if that happens, move B200 to wave3 and announce as backfill.

raj: i'll schedule vendor confirm calls today and collect SKUs/assets. if partners give go, we'll lock EOD Wed.

anna: summary + action items incoming from me in a follow-up message. thanks everyone.

anna: quick schedule snippet for the thread:
```
Wave1 (press + SI): H100, H200 — lock by Wed EOD
Wave2 (marketplace listing): MI300, Gaudi — publish ~+2 weeks
Wave3 (backfill): B200 — contingent on firmware
```

anna: action items: raj -> vendor confirms + asset list; nick -> perf and cert ETA; tina -> SI acceptance checklist; tess -> hero visuals; partner-bot -> calendar invites.

raj: ping me if anyone wants 1:1 vendor prep before the calendar call.

partner-bot: vendor invites accepted: @nvidia-pm, @amd-pm pending; @habana-pm accepted.

anna: great — closing thread for now, will post the official carveout plan shortly.
